Handmade things, made slowly, by real people.

Terra & Thread is a marketplace for pottery, weaving and woodwork from 48 independent makers. Every piece is one of a kind, and 80% of each sale goes straight to the maker.

Shop handmadeMeet the makers
48independent makers
80%of each sale to the maker
12khappy homes

New from the studios

Small batches, so when it's gone, it's gone.

Meet the makers

Every maker is visited by our team before they join, so you always know who made your piece.

Ines Duarte

Potter · Porto, Portugal

Wheel-thrown stoneware in soft, glossy glazes, fired in a wood kiln she built herself.

Kofi Mensah

Weaver · Kumasi, Ghana

Hand-loomed cotton throws and cushions using patterns passed down through four generations.

Elin Berg

Woodworker · Bergen, Norway

Serving boards and spoons carved from fallen birch and oak, finished with food-safe oil.

How made to order works

You order

Choose a piece and any size or colour options.

The maker makes

Your piece is made by hand in 1 to 3 weeks.

We check

Every item is checked and wrapped in recycled paper.

It arrives

Delivered with a card signed by the maker.

Give a gift card

Let them choose something handmade. Sent by email with your message, and valid for two years.

Terra & Thread gift card$50For someone special

From happy homes

"The vase is even lovelier in person. The note from Ines made my day."

Charlotte, Bristol

"Kofi's throw is on our sofa every evening. You can feel the care in it."

Marcus, Chicago

"Ordered wedding gifts for eight friends. Each one was different and perfect."

Ana, Lisbon

Questions

Is every piece really handmade?

Yes. Every item is made by hand by the maker named on the page. No mass production and no factories.

Why does my piece look a little different from the photo?

Because it's handmade, each piece has small differences in glaze, colour and texture. That's what makes it one of a kind.

Can I become a maker?

We welcome applications from independent makers. Send us photos of your work and we'll arrange a studio visit.

# Handicraft Store

Creator: mmrahmanbappi
Source: https://github.com/mmrahmanbappi/100-free-html-templates/blob/bab6ec6c8900450aab90989d217942a67ad9b16d/ecommerce/handicraft-store/index.html

Extract the ZIP and open index.html. No build, npm dependencies or remote CDN is required.

The upstream/ folder preserves original source with its MIT notice. Root index.html is the separately documented MigBits adaptation.

Replace fictional sample business content, connect your own backend and retain the included license notices. Forms, data and payments are demonstrations.

Use Pause motion or your operating system reduced-motion preference. Full production and accessibility review remains your responsibility.

Original single-file HTML/CSS/inline JavaScript retained separately with creator MIT notice.

Stock photography, external fonts, favicons, metadata and remote services are excluded from the runnable edition; original HTML references are preserved as text only.

Original MigBits geometric demo artwork and motion controls are separate adaptations. Forms and checkout are frontend demonstrations, not backend services.

No React conversion is claimed. System font fallback changes the upstream typography. Render validation is not a complete accessibility audit.

Mobile grid minimum widths and word wrapping are corrected for community-center and nonprofit-charity. Dynamic photo references and initially empty image viewers use original artwork.

The original download-promotion toolbar is removed from runnable pages; creator attribution and complete copyright notices remain. Photo credit labels reflect the replacement MigBits artwork.
